summary.zh-CN: SltBox 2026110701：新增 30 款花草植物装饰、到访摘果和默认关闭的水族馆桌面背景；同步校准增加 20 秒倒计时与最多 3 次重试，修复到访果实显示、2D 天空云层与闪帧，完善动物图鉴及快捷方式拖动排列。
summary.en-US: SltBox 2026110701 adds 30 flora decorations, fruit picking during tree visits and optional aquarium wallpaper; bounds manual tree calibration with a 20-second countdown and up to three retries, addresses 2D clouds and flashing, and improves wildlife details and shortcut reordering.
